pages.lesson:
LESSON: SELECTED SURAH

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Selected surah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Selected surah. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Use the selected surah in Swalah.
2. Handle the Qur’an with respect as it is the word of Allah. Core-Competences to be developed: communication digital literacy, critical thinking and problem solving ,self efficacy

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Use the selected surah in Swalah.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use the selected surah in Swalah. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Handle the Qur’an with respect as it is the word of Allah. Core-Competences to be developed: communication digital literacy, critical thinking and problem solving ,self efficacy
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to handle the Qur’an with respect as it is the word of Allah. Core-Competences to be developed: communication digital literacy, critical thinking and problem solving ,self efficacy. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Selected surah.
2. Explain Selected surah to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Selected surah.
4. Show that you can: Use the selected surah in Swalah.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Selected surah. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Selected surah important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Use the selected surah in Swalah.
2. Handle the Qur’an with respect as it is the word of Allah. Core-Competences to be developed: communication digital literacy, critical thinking and problem solving ,self efficacy

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
